title: Ergopti+ features manifest
description: JSON Schema for _shared/modules/features/manifest.toml — the single source of truth that drives first-boot config generation and tray-menu rendering in both drivers.

clear_exclude.description: Paths a clear leaves as they are, in this scope and in every scope that includes it.

type.description: Derived from neutral and recommended source values by the generator.

sections_root.description: Top-level sections registry. Keys are section names; nested tables follow the same shape recursively.

order.description: Ordered list of top-level section names; drives both menu order and config.toml emission order.

section_node.description: Metadata for a single section path. Nested sub-section tables appear as further keys on this same table.

subsections.description: Ordered list of child section names for menu/render ordering.

features_root.description: Top-level features registry. Keys are section paths (dot-separated mirrored as nested tables); values are arrays-of-tables of feature entries.

default.description: Primitive (bool/number/string/array) OR table. Mutually optional with default_per_platform — exactly one of them must be set.

default_per_platform.description: Per-platform default value. Use only when the default legitimately differs per driver.

recommended.description: Explicit Ergopti preset; never an implicit absence default.

active_by_default.description: Only on an input_altering entry the maintainer decided to switch on in an empty configuration (the script-management chords, 2026-09-30). Its default must equal its recommended value on every platform; every other input-altering entry defaults to off.

cleared.description: Required with active_by_default, forbidden without it: the off value (false, "none" or "") a clear writes explicitly, because deleting the key restores the preset.

reason_key.description: Locale key explaining WHY this feature is unavailable on the platforms its "platforms" list excludes. Read by the platform-coverage report (Menu → Debug → Healthcheck), which is the only place a user can ask why a row is missing. Meaningless without a platforms restriction, and the generator refuses one that has none.

superseded_reason_key.description: Locale key explaining why this feature is off while the Windows driver emulates a registry layout (layout.emulated_layout): the master gate turns it off and the menu greys its row with this reason. Only on a Windows-only boolean; the generator refuses it anywhere else.

choice_values.description: Optional ordered integer presentation choices on a numeric feature. The generator validates contiguity and default/recommended membership; numeric configuration storage is unchanged.
